notes: The *even* of *even from the children of Hobab* is appositional and stands before a phrase no object marker marks, so it is added; it is not part of the מִן's rendering, since *from* alone states that relation in full (rule 16).
s022 is the preposition אֵת (H854), not the object marker, and takes the copula of its prepositional predicate (rules 16, 49). Variant WLC.JDG.4.11.v001 was resolved in the projection (rule 9).
